name: zoom-buttons
description: Two square buttons, plus above minus, glued into one column in the bottom right corner of a positioned container. Emits ds-zoom-step with direction 1 or -1; the host does the zooming.
rationale: Requested by the maintainer (2026-10-11) for the CV Preview pane, in the look of the sidebar collapse toggle (.ds-sidebar-list__toggle): same size (spacing-row by spacing-9), thin dark-passive border, accent-1 mask icon, bg-surface-pressed on hover, focus ring as the toggle. No Figma node exists for it, so source is none; the minus icon is drawn as the counterpart of icons/add.svg and staged beside the component. The two buttons share one border (negative margin of the border width) so they read as one control. Staged in local-components until maintainer confirms it goes into dis-system.
a11y_notes: Native buttons with aria-label (Zoom in, Zoom out), grouped with role=group and a label. A button at the zoom limit is disabled. Icons are decorative (aria-hidden).
